findingsunresolved.title: Case aliases receive different canvas locks on case-insensitive macOS filesystems
findingsunresolved.cause: os.path.normcase is a no-op on macOS; final basename is lexical and hash differs for board and Board even when both names identify the same data inode.
findingsunresolved.reproduction: Create global board, record revision, pause writer A for board at Path.replace while it holds its real lock; save Board with the same expectedRevision; B succeeds while A is paused, then A succeeds and overwrites B.
findingsunresolved.remediation: Derive stable lock identity according to the owning filesystem equivalence rules, including aliases when data does not exist, and preserve that identity across deletion/recreation. Add a real case-insensitive same-revision contention regression. Do not unconditionally merge case-distinct files on case-sensitive filesystems.
